claims.statement: The apply_slot_correction action was attempted but failed due to scope error: the correction was applied to the wrong carrier feed, confirming that the east-node slot lag identified in C10 requires more precise intervention
claims.corroboration: Tier-1 observability report confirms the feed mismatch and lack of impact
claims.limitation: The mitigation approach was correct (fix slot closure), but the implementation scope was wrong

next_action.rationale: C10 established the root cause as the timing mismatch created by v18's split-reservation routing to east node. C12 shows the slot-correction approach failed in implementation. Reverting v18 (east-node reservation priority) is reversible and idempotent per the human gate conditions; it will prevent the split-reservation routing that creates orders booking to the east-node feed with insufficient slot closure window. This is a more reliable mitigation than attempting a scoped slot correction that requires precise feed identification.
next_action.expected_information_gain: Reverting v18 will move EXC-0921 orders back to the previous allocation rule set, which did not route them to the east node; this should release the held orders for carrier pickup and demonstrate that v18's routing change is the root cause.
